rubric.statement: `Example` payloads are supported; in the `access_examples` path, `Parallel` invokes the callee with `module(**example.inputs())`.
`dict` payloads are supported and are forwarded as keyword arguments via `module(**example)`.
`tuple` payloads are supported and are forwarded as positional arguments via `module(*example)`.

`list` payloads are only accepted for the special nested case where the callee's class name is exactly `Parallel`; the nested test constructs `(self.parallel, [ ... ])` and expects that entry to return a nested sub-run result.
Any payload outside the supported `Example`/`dict`/`list`/`tuple` branches raises `ValueError`.
